LanguageData.KoRimUtility.Suppression.GainHelp: Changes suppression gained on a successful attempt. Does not change eligibility or success chance.
LanguageData.KoRimUtility.Suppression.DifficultyHelp: Lower values increase success chance. The minimum requirements remain Social {0} and suppression power {1}. Slaves with stronger combat abilities and lower suppression are harder to suppress.
LanguageData.KoRimUtility.Suppression.MoodHelp: Successful suppression gives the slave a non-stacking mood effect for one day. Penalties are -5, -10 or -15, based on suppression before the attempt. Slavery: Honorable halves the penalty. Masochists instead receive a fixed +5. A new success replaces the effect and restarts its duration. Failure changes neither suppression nor mood.
LanguageData.KoRimUtility.Suppression.Requirements: Requires Social {0}, suppression power {1}, and the ability to perform warden work, speak and manipulate.
LanguageData.KoRimUtility.Suppression.AlertExplanatio: These slaves need suppression, but no capable colonist on their map is assigned to warden work. A warden needs at least Social {0}, suppression power {1}, and the ability to speak and manipulate. Check work assignments, skills, equipment and health. Sleeping, other jobs and the normal one-day suppression interval do not trigger this warning by themselves.
